youtube_description:
I know for a fact that many producers that work on a PC want to upgrade to universal audio interfaces but are too scared.

In this video I will show you what you need in order to setup the Apollo Mk II on windows operating system.

I also included the list of gear I bought in order to make the Apollo twin MKii to work with my windows PC machine.

Where I bought mine:
Universal Audio Apollo Twin MkII - DUO -  http://bit.ly/2pKuqIk
2M Premium Thunderbolt Cable - https://amzn.to/30gHeud
Thunderbolt 3 to Thunderbolt 2 Adapter - https://amzn.to/3mX3Tpc
